description: This file contains platform-specific functions and utilities for firmware upgrade, identification, parsing, and validation for BCM4908-based devices. It includes functions for reading binary content, handling firmware formats (like pkgtb and bcm4908img), performing upgrades via UBI or raw flashing, and identifying device models based on firmware headers.

methods.name: get_content
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from a file at a given offset.

methods.name: get_hex_u32_le
methods.description: Reads 4 bytes from a file at a given offset and outputs as a little-endian hex string.

methods.name: get_hex_u32_be
methods.description: Reads 4 bytes from a file at a given offset and outputs as a big-endian hex string.

methods.name: platform_expected_image
methods.description: Returns the expected device image name based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_identify
methods.description: Identifies the firmware format and device type by examining headers and magic numbers in the firmware file.

methods.name: platform_pkgtb_get_image_name
methods.description: Retrieves the image name from a pkgtb firmware configuration.

methods.name: platform_pkgtb_get_image
methods.description: Extracts image data from a pkgtb formatted firmware file.

methods.name: platform_pkgtb_get_upgrade_index
methods.description: Gets the current upgrade index for pkgtb images (for dual-partition management).

methods.name: platform_pkgtb_commit
methods.description: Commits the new firmware environment variables for pkgtb upgrades.

methods.name: platform_check_pkgtb
methods.description: Validates the presence of 'bootfs' and 'rootfs' images in pkgtb firmware.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Validates the firmware image, ensuring it matches the device and format requirements.

methods.name: platform_pkgtb_clean_rootfs_data
methods.description: Cleans or verifies the 'rootfs_data' partition for pkgtb upgrades.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_pkgtb
methods.description: Performs a firmware upgrade using pkgtb format, updating UBI volumes accordingly.

methods.name: platform_calc_new_cferam
methods.description: Calculates and returns the new cferam index for firmware versioning.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_ubi
methods.description: Performs a UBI-aware upgrade, flashing boot and root filesystems, and updating cferam index.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade dispatcher that detects format and performs appropriate upgrade steps, including fallback to full image flashing.
